description: Fetch a page and audit core on-page SEO signals: title/meta description length, canonical tag, heading structure, image alt text coverage, viewport tag, robots meta, word count, plus response security headers, hreflang, OpenGraph/Twitter cards, http-to-https redirect, static tech markers, static accessibility checks (contrast is not measured), English-only Flesch readability, and a homepage-only broken-link check (up to 25 links). Failures carry a typed reason (blocked_403, not_found, timeout, ...). Returns a list of concrete issues found. Single page only — not a site crawl.
name: site_audit
title: On-page SEO audit
